scientific_integrity: Complete argument for finite-variable equivalence is in RESULT.md, with bounded computational corroboration; literature priority is provisional, and no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty simple undirected threshold graphs; pure adjacency and equality; counting-free FO with at most k reusable variables, unrestricted rank; canonical minima relative to this family. No claim for general cographs, colored graphs, counting logic, or optimal quantifier rank.
title: Exact fixed-variable theories and rational order spectra of threshold graphs
